column1: # Clausecker, ZIB Report 20-17, Fig. 5.3 (Manhattan heuristic quality histogram), digitized
# from the PDF's vector drawing: the data polyline in the content stream at byte offset 91161 of
# papers/ZR-20-17.pdf, mapped by the gridlines (y = 25.199 pt -> 0, 173.876 pt -> 6e-21) and x
# ticks (53.943 pt -> k = 0, 437.159 pt -> k = 65). Coordinates carry 3 decimals, so values are
# quantised to ~1.1e-24. The polyline sits one quantum above the axis where the true value is
# far below it (k = 0..13 plot as 1.13e-24), so 'eta_k_offset_removed' subtracts 1.13e-24.
# The same procedure on Fig. 5.2 (stream at offset 79053) reproduces |V_k|/|V| b^-k from the
# sphere sizes to within its quantum (max difference 4.7e-29, peak 1.3e-25).
